payload.credit_html: A new styracosternan hadrosauroid (Dinosauria: Ornithischia) from the Early Cretaceous of Portell, Spain
payload.description_html:
Photograph of the right dentary of the holotype (MQ98-II-1) of the hadrosauroid Portellsaurus sosbaynati (Santos-Cubedo et al., 2021).

A is the labial view; B is the lingual view; C is the occlusal view; D is a 2x enlargement.

Scale bars equal 10 centimetres.
